description.value: Meares Retreat is a small, intimate two-suite waterfront bed & breakfast perched on an 80-foot cliff above the Pacific Ocean near Tofino, BC, with sweeping ocean and mountain views from each private-entrance suite. Both suites feature gas fireplaces, private outdoor hot tubs on a cliff-top deck, and a continental breakfast tray delivered to the door each morning. The property sits minutes from Tonquin Beach and local hiking trails, making it a scenic and secluded base for exploring BC's wild west coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Meares Retreat as an operating two-suite waterfront B&B at 140 Arnet Road, Tofino, corroborating OSM address and both phone numbers (local 250-725-4234 and toll-free 1-877-725-4234). No mention of bicycle storage, bike-specific services, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any cycling amenities appears anywhere in the website text. OSM tags the property as tourism=apartment, but the website consistently describes it as a bed & breakfast.
concerns: OSM tags the property as tourism=apartment; the website clearly identifies it as a bed & breakfast.
Website copyright footer reads 2011, suggesting the site may not have been updated recently, though operational content appears current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating waterfront B&B with an active website, confirmed address, and booking form. A legitimate accommodation option for touring cyclists visiting Tofino.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags as tourism=apartment; website consistently identifies it as a bed & breakfast, which is the correct accommodation sub-type.
